::: {.callout-note}
## Purpose (本章目标)

理解 Shell 作为进程创建接口的角色；掌握管道、重定向、引号与变量展开的解析规则；认识到词法层面的歧义如何处理。

> **English:** Understand the shell as a process-creation interface; master parsing rules for pipes, redirection, quoting, and variable expansion.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Projects in this chapter (本章项目与来源高校)

[016 MIT](../universities/mit.qmd)

## The shell in the system hierarchy (Shell 在系统层次中的位置)

MIT 6.858 的系统安全实验让学生从最底层理解进程。Shell 是用户与内核之间的解释器：它解析一行文本，把它变成一组 `fork`/`exec`/`pipe`/`dup2` 系统调用。本项目聚焦前半部分——解析。真正的执行留给练习。

> **English:** A shell is an interpreter between user and kernel: it turns a line of text into fork/exec/pipe/dup2 calls. Our case study focuses on the parsing half.

## Quoting and tokenization (引号与分词)

`shlex.split` 正确处理 `'hello world'` 为单个 token，而朴素的 `str.split()` 会拆成两个。这个差异看起来微小，但它体现了词法分析的核心原则：分隔符在引号内失效。

> **English:** shlex.split keeps 'hello world' as one token; naive splitting breaks it. This illustrates the core lexical principle: delimiters lose meaning inside quotes.

## Variable expansion (变量展开)

`$HOME` 在解析阶段展开为环境变量值。展开时机很重要：它在分词之后、执行之前进行，否则含空格的变量值会被错误拆分。

> **English:** Variable expansion happens after tokenization but before execution — expanding earlier would incorrectly split values containing spaces.

### Real measured output (真实运行输出)

```text
[shell] [Command(['cat', 'input.txt'], ...), Command(['grep', 'hello'], ..., out=out.txt)]
[shell] [Command(['echo', 'hello world'], ..., out=log.txt, append=True)]
[shell] [Command(['echo', '/home/user'], ...)]
[shell] pipeline of 3 commands: [['wc', '-l'], ['sort'], ['uniq']]
--- PASS: test_shell
```

## Fallacies and Pitfalls (常见误解)

::: {.callout-warning}
## Fallacy：管道符可以按字符分割
引号内的 `|` 不是管道符。教学版简化处理；工业级 shell 必须在词法层区分。
:::

## Self-Check (自测题)

1. 为什么 `shlex.split` 优于 `str.split`？
2. 变量展开应在分词之前还是之后？

<details><summary>答案</summary>
1. 它尊重引号与转义，避免把引号内空格当分隔符。
2. 之后——否则含空格的变量值会被拆成多个参数。
</details>

## Summary (本章小结)

Shell 是解析与进程创建的结合；词法规则决定语义正确性；真实系统需在词法层处理引号内的特殊字符。
